purpose: Public coverage inventory for country racing systems, official sources, racecourse scope, and current timetable status.

coverage_terms.not_started: The source or racing system is known, but no reviewed timetable records are published.
coverage_terms.initial_seed_only: A small source-reviewed record set exists, but it is not broad coverage and must not be presented as complete.
coverage_terms.partial: Some usable active-window records exist, but the country or racing system is not fully covered.
coverage_terms.out_of_window_seed: Reviewed records exist outside the active Today, Tomorrow, or 30-day window and must not be treated as current calendar coverage.
coverage_terms.broad: A substantial portion of the known official calendar is represented, but final completeness still requires review.
coverage_terms.complete: All known in-scope official systems, racecourses, calendar sources, and active-window meetings have been reviewed for the declared coverage window.

global_rules: Do not call a country complete unless every active official racing system has a source, racecourse scope, and coverage review.
Do not treat initial records as complete country coverage.
Do not treat records outside the active 30-day window as useful current calendar coverage.
Do not publish racecards, entries, horse names, jockey names, odds, results, payouts, predictions, tips, raw HTML, or source response bodies.
Official source links remain the final confirmation point.
